caption: ATLAS Behavior Map AI Attribute Dictionary
description: Attributes added by the abm extension. Attributes already defined by the OCSF core dictionary (uid, name, desc, url, version, tactics, technique, classification, ...) are referenced, not redefined.
name: dictionary

accuracy_drop_pct.caption: Accuracy Drop (%)
accuracy_drop_pct.description: Accuracy drop against the canary/validation set, in percentage points.

acting_above_user_privilege.caption: Acting Above User Privilege
acting_above_user_privilege.description: The agent's credential for this call holds privileges the requesting user does not.

action_name.caption: Action Name
action_name.description: Response action from the abm action registry. For example: block_request, revoke_token.

actor_is_conversation_owner.caption: Actor Is Conversation Owner
actor_is_conversation_owner.description: The principal writing the memory entry owns the conversation it is attached to.

ai_artifact.caption: AI Artifact
ai_artifact.description: Model, dataset, package or container image involved in the activity.

ai_completion.caption: AI Completion
ai_completion.description: The model output and signals computed over it.

ai_context_record.caption: AI Context Record
ai_context_record.description: Retrieved document, vector-store record or agent memory entry.

ai_guardrail.caption: AI Guardrail
ai_guardrail.description: Verdicts and scores from AI security controls that inspected the request.

ai_prompt.caption: AI Prompt
ai_prompt.description: The prompt sent to a generative AI model and lexical signals computed over it.

ai_tool_call.caption: AI Tool Call
ai_tool_call.description: An AI agent tool, function or MCP operation.

ai_training.caption: AI Training
ai_training.description: Training, fine-tuning or data-pipeline job context.

architecture_hash_match.caption: Architecture Hash Match
architecture_hash_match.description: The model graph/architecture hash matches the registered architecture.

artifact_type.caption: Artifact Type
artifact_type.description: Kind of AI artifact. For example: model_weights, dataset, package, container_image.

atlas_mapping.caption: ATLAS Mapping
atlas_mapping.description: MITRE ATLAS tactics, techniques and mitigations for this finding, pinned to an ATLAS data version. Carried in the extension because attacks[] has no field for the technique relationship or the matrix version of mixed ATT&CK/ATLAS lists.

atlas_relationship.caption: ATLAS Relationship
atlas_relationship.description: How the technique relates to the detected behavior: primary, secondary or precondition.

attachment_count.caption: Attachment Count
attachment_count.description: Number of attachments in a message the agent sent.

backdoor_anomaly_index.caption: Backdoor Anomaly Index
backdoor_anomaly_index.description: Anomaly index reported by a backdoor scanner (for example Neural Cleanse).

batch_uid.caption: Batch UID
batch_uid.description: Identifier of the ingested data batch.

blast_radius.caption: Blast Radius
blast_radius.description: Scope the action affects. For example: request, session, principal, model.

budget_approved.caption: Budget Approved
budget_approved.description: The job's compute budget was approved.

caller_clearance.caption: Caller Clearance
caller_clearance.description: Highest sensitivity label the calling principal is cleared for.

change_target.caption: Change Target
change_target.description: Agent configuration element that was changed. For example: system_prompt, tools.

channel.caption: Channel
channel.description: Interaction channel the message arrived through. For example: chat, api, email, support_ticket.

check_type.caption: Check Type
check_type.description: Kind of biometric or verification check performed. For example: liveness.

checksum_match.caption: Checksum Match
checksum_match.description: The dataset checksum matches the published checksum.

cited_unretrieved_sources.caption: Cited Unretrieved Sources
cited_unretrieved_sources.description: Number of sources cited in the completion that were not part of the retrieved context (fabricated citations).

cloud_api.caption: Cloud API
cloud_api.description: Cloud control-plane API the agent called through the tool.

confusable_char_ratio.caption: Confusable Character Ratio
confusable_char_ratio.description: Fraction (0-1) of prompt characters that are Unicode confusables (homoglyphs) of ASCII characters.

content.caption: Content
content.description: Text content. For ai_prompt the full prompt sent to the model, for ai_completion the model output, for ai_context_record the retrieved document, vector record or memory entry. See specific usage.

context_has_untrusted_content.caption: Context Has Untrusted Content
context_has_untrusted_content.description: Untrusted content (web page, email, retrieved document) was in the agent's context when it chose this call.

context_utilization.caption: Context Utilization
context_utilization.description: Fraction (0-1) of the model's context window consumed by the request.

contributor_uid.caption: Contributor UID
contributor_uid.description: Identifier of the contributor of the data.

cost_usd.caption: Cost (USD)
cost_usd.description: Billed or estimated cost of this message or tool step in US dollars, as reported by the AI gateway or agent runtime.

decision_margin.caption: Decision Margin
decision_margin.description: Margin between the top-1 and top-2 class scores.

decompression_ratio.caption: Decompression Ratio
decompression_ratio.description: Decompressed-to-compressed size ratio of the input (decompression-bomb indicator).

destination_allowlisted.caption: Destination Allowlisted
destination_allowlisted.description: The network destination of the call is on the agent egress allowlist.

dialogue_turns.caption: Dialogue Turns
dialogue_turns.description: Number of dialogue turns embedded in a single prompt (many-shot or fake-conversation indicator).

digest_match.caption: Digest Match
digest_match.description: The artifact digest matches the digest recorded at publication.

distribution_shift_psi.caption: Distribution Shift (PSI)
distribution_shift_psi.description: Population stability index of the batch against the reference distribution.

doc_sensitivity.caption: Document Sensitivity
doc_sensitivity.description: Sensitivity label of the retrieved document.

environment.caption: Environment
environment.description: Deployment or workspace environment the activity ran in. For example: prod, dev, sandbox, or a notebook/workspace name. See specific usage.

file_path.caption: File Path
file_path.description: File system path the tool read or wrote.

file_sha256.caption: File SHA-256
file_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the file submitted for inference.

fuzzy_hash_cluster.caption: Fuzzy Hash Cluster
fuzzy_hash_cluster.description: Cluster label of the input's fuzzy hash (near-duplicate probing indicator).

guardrail_verdict.caption: Guardrail Verdict
guardrail_verdict.description: Verdict of the prompt guardrail. For example: pass, prompt_injection, jailbreak.

harm_score.caption: Harm Score
harm_score.description: Harmful-content score (0-1) from the moderation layer.

has_citations.caption: Has Citations
has_citations.description: The completion contains citations to sources.

human_approved.caption: Human Approved
human_approved.description: A human approved this tool call before it ran.

initiated_by_user.caption: Initiated By User
initiated_by_user.description: The tool call was directly requested by the user rather than chosen autonomously by the agent.

input_embedding_norm.caption: Input Embedding Norm
input_embedding_norm.description: L2 norm of the input embedding.

input_modality.caption: Input Modality
input_modality.description: Modality of the input. For example: text, image, audio.

input_quality_score.caption: Input Quality Score
input_quality_score.description: Quality score (0-1) of the input, for example image sharpness or audio SNR.

input_similarity_to_prev.caption: Input Similarity To Previous
input_similarity_to_prev.description: Similarity (0-1) between this input and the caller's previous input (systematic-probing indicator).

inter_arrival_s.caption: Inter-arrival Seconds
inter_arrival_s.description: Seconds since the previous message from the same caller in the same message context. Computed by an enrichment step; absent for the first message.

invisible_char_count.caption: Invisible Character Count
invisible_char_count.description: Number of zero-width, tag or other non-rendering Unicode characters in the prompt.

is_external_egress.caption: External Egress
is_external_egress.description: 1 when the call sent data outside the organization, otherwise 0. Integer so it can be summed.

is_secret_read.caption: Secret Read
is_secret_read.description: 1 when the call read a secret or credential store, otherwise 0. Integer so it can be summed.

is_timeout.caption: Timeout
is_timeout.description: 1 when the inference request timed out, otherwise 0. Integer so it can be summed.

jailbreak_corpus_match.caption: Jailbreak Corpus Match
jailbreak_corpus_match.description: The prompt matched an entry in a known-jailbreak corpus.

job_uid.caption: Job UID
job_uid.description: Identifier of the training or fine-tuning job.

label_disagreement_rate.caption: Label Disagreement Rate
label_disagreement_rate.description: Fraction (0-1) of labels that disagree with a reference labeler.

logprobs_requested.caption: Log-probabilities Requested
logprobs_requested.description: The request asked the model to return token log-probabilities.

malware_signature_hits.caption: Malware Signature Hits
malware_signature_hits.description: Number of malware signatures matched by the artifact scanner.

manifest_hash_approved.caption: Manifest Hash Approved
manifest_hash_approved.description: The hash of the tool/server manifest matches an approved version.

memorization_score.caption: Memorization Score
memorization_score.description: Score (0-1) from a memorization detector estimating that the completion reproduces training data verbatim.

mitigations.caption: Mitigations
mitigations.description: The MITRE ATLAS mitigations (AML.M*) bound to the detected behavior.

moderation_verdict.caption: Moderation Verdict
moderation_verdict.description: Verdict of the content moderation layer. For example: allow, block.

name_similarity_to_approved.caption: Name Similarity To Approved
name_similarity_to_approved.description: Similarity (0-1) between the tool name and the closest approved tool name (typosquat indicator).

near_duplicate_score.caption: Near-duplicate Score
near_duplicate_score.description: Similarity (0-1) of the record to existing records in the collection (bulk-poisoning indicator).

package_age_days.caption: Package Age (days)
package_age_days.description: Days since the package, tool or server version was first published.

page_trust.caption: Page Trust
page_trust.description: Trust level of the web page a browsing agent acted on. For example: trusted, untrusted.

patch_detector_score.caption: Patch Detector Score
patch_detector_score.description: Score (0-1) from an adversarial-patch detector on image inputs.

pipeline_uid.caption: Pipeline UID
pipeline_uid.description: Identifier of the data or training pipeline.

plan_status.caption: Plan Status
plan_status.description: Execution status of the action. For example: auto, awaiting_approval, executed(dry-run).

predicted_label.caption: Predicted Label
predicted_label.description: Label the model returned to the caller.

prediction_changed_by_trigger.caption: Prediction Changed By Trigger
prediction_changed_by_trigger.description: Removing the suspected trigger from the input changes the prediction.

principal_in_dataset_acl.caption: Principal In Dataset ACL
principal_in_dataset_acl.description: The acting principal is on the dataset's access list.

prompt_hash.caption: Prompt Hash
prompt_hash.description: Hash or fingerprint of the normalized prompt. Lets detections correlate repeated prompts without storing prompt text.

provenance_signed.caption: Provenance Signed
provenance_signed.description: The batch carries a signed provenance attestation.

publisher.caption: Publisher
publisher.description: Publisher or namespace of the artifact on its hub. For example: meta-llama.

publisher_allowlisted.caption: Publisher Allowlisted
publisher_allowlisted.description: The publisher is on the organization's allowlist.

publisher_similarity_to_allowlisted.caption: Publisher Similarity To Allowlisted
publisher_similarity_to_allowlisted.description: Similarity (0-1) between the publisher and the closest allowlisted publisher (namespace-squatting indicator).

publisher_verified.caption: Publisher Verified
publisher_verified.description: The tool or server publisher identity is verified.

raw_html.caption: Raw HTML
raw_html.description: Raw HTML of a retrieved web page before text extraction (hidden-instruction carrier).

reasoning_tokens.caption: Reasoning Tokens
reasoning_tokens.description: Number of hidden reasoning tokens the model spent on this message. Reasoning models report these separately from completion_tokens.

recipient_external.caption: Recipient External
recipient_external.description: A recipient of the message the agent sent is outside the organization.

record_count.caption: Record Count
record_count.description: Number of records in the batch or dataset.

records_returned.caption: Records Returned
records_returned.description: Number of records the operation returned.

refused.caption: Refused
refused.description: 1 when the model refused the request, otherwise 0. Integer so detections can sum refusals over a window.

request_param_keys.caption: Request Parameter Keys
request_param_keys.description: Comma-separated names of the generation parameters set on the request. For example: temperature,logprobs,logit_bias.

requested_gpu_hours.caption: Requested GPU Hours
requested_gpu_hours.description: GPU hours requested by the job.

requires_approval.caption: Requires Approval
requires_approval.description: A human must approve the action before it runs.

response_plan.caption: Response Plan
response_plan.description: Countermeasure actions planned for this finding, with approval gating and execution status.

return_confidence.caption: Return Confidence
return_confidence.description: 1 when confidence scores were returned to the caller, otherwise 0.

server_auth_type.caption: Server Auth Type
server_auth_type.description: How the agent authenticated to the MCP server or tool backend. For example: delegated_token, none.

server_first_seen_for_agent.caption: Server First Seen For Agent
server_first_seen_for_agent.description: First time this agent contacted this MCP server (enrichment).

server_in_agent_manifest.caption: Server In Agent Manifest
server_in_agent_manifest.description: The MCP server is declared in the agent's manifest.

source_domain_age_days.caption: Source Domain Age (days)
source_domain_age_days.description: Days since the source domain was registered (enrichment).

source_external.caption: Source External
source_external.description: The data came from outside the organization.

source_hub.caption: Source Hub
source_hub.description: Model or package hub the artifact came from. For example: huggingface, pypi.

source_system.caption: Source System
source_system.description: System of record the content was retrieved from. For example: sharepoint, confluence.

source_trust.caption: Source Trust
source_trust.description: Trust level of the record's source. For example: trusted, untrusted.

source_type.caption: Source Type
source_type.description: Kind of source the record came from. For example: web, email, kb.

speaker_consent_on_file.caption: Speaker Consent On File
speaker_consent_on_file.description: Consent from the voice owner is on file for this synthesis request.

speaker_is_protected_person.caption: Speaker Is Protected Person
speaker_is_protected_person.description: The target voice belongs to a protected person (executive, public figure).

suffix_perplexity.caption: Suffix Perplexity
suffix_perplexity.description: Perplexity of the prompt suffix under a reference language model. High values indicate optimized adversarial suffixes.

suffix_token_count.caption: Suffix Token Count
suffix_token_count.description: Number of tokens in the high-perplexity prompt suffix.

suggested_by_llm.caption: Suggested By LLM
suggested_by_llm.description: The package was suggested by an AI coding assistant (slopsquatting indicator).

target_category.caption: Target Category
target_category.description: Category of the element a browsing agent clicked. For example: link, file_download, oauth_consent.

target_environment.caption: Target Environment
target_environment.description: Environment the job's output is destined for.

task.caption: Task
task.description: Task requested from the model endpoint. For example: classify, tts, voice_clone.

techniques.caption: ATLAS Techniques
techniques.description: The MITRE ATLAS techniques mapped to the detection, each with its relationship to the behavior.

tenant_mismatch.caption: Tenant Mismatch
tenant_mismatch.description: The record belongs to a different tenant than the caller.

tier.caption: Model Tier
tier.description: Capability or pricing tier of the model. For example: frontier, standard, mini.

tool_args.caption: Tool Arguments
tool_args.description: Arguments of the tool invocation, serialized as the agent runtime logged them.

tool_category.caption: Tool Category
tool_category.description: Functional category of the tool. For example: data_read, shell, browser, email.

tool_in_scope.caption: Tool In Scope
tool_in_scope.description: The tool is in the agent's declared tool scope for this task.

tool_name.caption: Tool Name
tool_name.description: Name of the tool, function or MCP tool the agent invoked or registered. For example: shell.exec, payments.transfer.

tool_output.caption: Tool Output
tool_output.description: Output the tool returned to the agent.

tool_risk.caption: Tool Risk
tool_risk.description: Risk rating of the tool in the agent's tool registry. For example: low, high.

top_k.caption: Top K
top_k.description: Number of nearest neighbours requested by the vector query.

trigger_asr.caption: Trigger Attack Success Rate
trigger_asr.description: Attack success rate (0-1) of the strongest reconstructed backdoor trigger.

trigger_detector_score.caption: Trigger Detector Score
trigger_detector_score.description: Score (0-1) from a backdoor-trigger detector on the input.

typosquat_score.caption: Typosquat Score
typosquat_score.description: Score (0-1) that the package name typosquats a popular package.

unsafe_opcode_count.caption: Unsafe Opcode Count
unsafe_opcode_count.description: Number of unsafe deserialization opcodes (for example pickle GLOBAL/REDUCE) found by the model scanner.

uploader_uid.caption: Uploader UID
uploader_uid.description: Identifier of the principal that uploaded the record.

user_content.caption: User Content
user_content.description: The end-user supplied portion of the prompt, separated from system and template text by the gateway.

via_app_gateway.caption: Via App Gateway
via_app_gateway.description: The request came through the application tier rather than directly to the model endpoint.

workload_type.caption: Workload Type
workload_type.description: Kind of workload the artifact is deployed as. For example: inference, training, agent.
